integrity: All stated finite-size identities proved by direct deletion and independent-attachment counting; asymptotic independence proved by mixed factorial moments. Self-review only, no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact enumeration through eight vertices corroborates but does not prove the infinite case. Joint Poisson asymptotic is fixed-dimensional. The previously known root/aggregate protection formulas are excluded from novelty; a 1991 related full-text source remains incompletely inspected.
title: Leaf-parent marks in recursive trees: a partial-rencontres law and asymptotically independent Poisson ages
